purpose: Next-step queue for deeper read-only Goofish/Xianyu page familiarization.

queueDefinitions.D1_HIGH_RISK_LIVE: Live pages with dense transaction, finance, permission, security, message, or paid-promotion impact. Observe headers, tabs, button categories, and modal states only.
queueDefinitions.D2_FORM_AND_SHELL_LIVE: Live forms, empty-state pages, draft pages, and workbench shells. Observe labels, validation hints, upload zones, empty states, and shell boundaries only.
queueDefinitions.D3_LOW_RISK_LIVE: Live public or low-risk pages. Observe navigation, cards, filters, and content containers without item identity values.
queueDefinitions.D4_REQUIRES_USER_CONTEXT: Deep parameter pages requiring a user-provided URL or business context. Never guess parameters.
queueDefinitions.D5_STATIC_ONLY: Static or internal-module evidence. Keep as static description; do not force-open.
queueDefinitions.D6_SHELL_BOUNDARY: Login or iframe container boundary. Identify the shell only.

nextActionByBucket.D1_HIGH_RISK_LIVE: Deepen only by reading field names, table headers, status labels, button categories, and modal categories. Do not open rows or execute actions.
nextActionByBucket.D2_FORM_AND_SHELL_LIVE: Deepen by reading form labels, input types, validation categories, empty states, and shell anchors. Do not upload, save, publish, submit, or download.
nextActionByBucket.D3_LOW_RISK_LIVE: Deepen by reading navigation, filter controls, public card structure, and route shape. Do not collect item identity values.
nextActionByBucket.D4_REQUIRES_USER_CONTEXT: Wait for user-provided URL or explicit business context; then do one read-only pass with parameter redaction.
nextActionByBucket.D5_STATIC_ONLY: Use static assets and API crosswalk only; do not force a live route.
nextActionByBucket.D6_SHELL_BOUNDARY: Identify shell/container type and stop at embedded or login boundary.
